user.title: XKNX Editor
user.description: XKNX Editor, the KNX project editor, appears in the sidebar for administrators. On its first start it installs itself into an environment of its own in the Home Assistant configuration folder, which takes a few minutes and needs internet access.

abort.single_instance_allowed: XKNX Editor is already set up.

data_description.allow_non_admins: Also users who are not administrators see XKNX Editor in the sidebar. The editor has no roles of its own: everyone who opens it can change the project and program devices on the KNX bus.
data_description.requirements: Leave empty for the editor release of this integration. Otherwise a URL or a path on the Home Assistant host of another requirements file, e.g. to try an editor build.

not_running.title: XKNX Editor is not running
